crossRefs.note: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them; that you may live, and go in…
You shall observe to do therefore as Yahweh your God has commanded you. You shall not turn away to the right hand or to…
If you love me, keep my commandments.

parallels.note: We have dealt very corruptly against you, and have not kept the commandments, nor the statutes, nor the ordinances…

translations.web: You shall therefore keep the commandments, the statutes, and the ordinances which I command you today, to do them.
translations.bsb: So keep the commandments and statutes and ordinances that I am giving you to follow this day.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandments, and the statutes, and the judgments, which I command thee this day, to do
translations.asv: Thou shalt therefore keep the commandment, and the statutes, and the ordinances, which I command thee this day, to do them.
